name: Bits and Pieces - Wooden Fold-and-Go Jigsaw Table-Collapsible Jigsaw Puzzle Table and Storage System - Puzzle Accessories Hobby Surface for Put
description: Beautifully finished in a rosewood stain with metal closure clips and carrying handle Reinforced support legs fold in and allow for convenient storage or travel. Fold-And-Go Wooden Jigsaw Table folds up to a compact 37-3/4" x 26-1/2" x 2-1/2" Puzzle Assembly Surface measures 25" x 34" Minor assembly required The Fold-And-Go Wooden Jigsaw Table is a pine wood table exclusively designed by Bits And Pieces. Non-slip felt makes this puzzle table the perfect hobby surface for putting together your jigsaw puzzles with comfort and ease. Two metal-reinforced fold-out side panels become sorting surfaces in seconds. They are topped with non-slip, felt-covered plywood pads to keep pieces from slipping. These side panels can lay flat for family-style puzzling or angle upwards to make it easier to reach your loose pieces. A unique magnetic bar is included to hold your puzzle box in place for easy picture reference. Reinforced support legs fold in and allow for convenient storage or travel. Take your puzzling to the next level with the ultimate jigsaw puzzle accessory.
